basic_info.description: 1530 Gough Street is a trophy Beaux-Arts corner building nestled in the heart of San Francisco's esteemed Lower Pacific Heights neighborhood. This distinguished property features 37 elegantly designed studio apartments and a generously sized 1BR/1BA unit, perfectly situated at the crossroads of the vibrant Polk Street, the beautifully revitalized Van Ness Avenue, and the culturally rich Japantown commercial corridors. Offering a rare opportunity to acquire a significant number of residences, this meticulously maintained, turnkey investment exemplifies timeless architecture and modern convenience.
